comment: The Key input's scaling is not a straight 1V per octave read: composites/Harmony2.h:259-267 takes the fractional part of the voltage, so the octave is discarded and the root wraps within twelve semitones. The XP input has no range field because the transposition it adds is unbounded in the code; the resulting degree is wrapped into the scale by ScaleNote::transposeDegree. Params 12 to 23 report state back to the panel and params 32 and 33 carry the two menu settings; none of them has a widget. The maker's manual lists the mode CV mapping with 12/12V absent and 13/12V as Chromatic; the code takes the voltage modulo the number of scales, so 12/12V is the first scale again.
